# Scentify Fragrances

> Scentify Fragrances (Pvt) Ltd imports Arabian and designer perfumes directly from the UAE and sells them online in Sri Lanka. Prices are in Sri Lankan rupees (LKR), delivery is island-wide, and Cash on Delivery is available.

## Shop
- [All fragrances](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/shop): the full catalogue of perfumes and gift sets
- [Brands](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/brands): Lattafa, Armaf, Afnan, Rasasi, French Avenue, Dior, Chanel and more
- [Men's](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/category/men), [Women's](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/category/women), [Unisex](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/category/unisex)
- [Arabian houses](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/category/arabian) and [Designer](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/category/designer)
- [Gift sets](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/category/gift-sets) and [Gift finder](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/gifts)

## Guides
- [All perfume guides](https://scentifyfragrances.lk/guides): Arabian perfumes, oud, EDP vs EDT, making fragrance last, perfume for Sri Lankan weather, spotting fake perfume, gift advice, how to order online

## Facts
- Business: Scentify Fragrances (Pvt) Ltd, Sri Lanka
- Products: eau de parfum, eau de toilette, extrait de parfum and boxed gift sets
- Currency: LKR. Payment: Cash on Delivery, bank transfer
- Service area: all of Sri Lanka
- Contact: order@scentifyfragrances.lk, WhatsApp and phone 077 005 5732, customer service 9:00 am – 9:00 pm
- Address: 22C Janatha Mawatha, Huludagoda Rd, Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka
